命.name: Life
命.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> with a roof over their head, a <radical>mouth</radical> and a <radical>stamp</radical>. The emperor's mouth speaks, the order is stamped, and your <kanji>life</kanji> depends on it.
命.reading: A maid, めい, delivers the order. 命令 is an order; いのち on its own is life.

福.name: Luck
福.meaning: An <radical>altar</radical> beside a full <radical>rice paddy</radical> with a <radical>mouth</radical> above it. Pray at the altar and the field feeds you. That's <kanji>luck</kanji>.
福.reading: Hang a lucky charm on a hook, ふく. 幸福 is happiness; 福岡 Fukuoka.

横.name: Side
横.meaning: A <radical>tree</radical> next to something <radical>yellow</radical>. The yellow tree fell over <kanji>side</kanji>ways.
横.reading: It lands on your foot: "ow!" おう. 横 on its own is よこ; 横断 crossing.

深.name: Deep
深.meaning: <radical>Water</radical>, a <radical>lid</radical> on <radical>legs</radical>, and a <radical>tree</radical>. The water is so <kanji>deep</kanji> a whole tree sinks with its lid on.
深.reading: ふかい: something who-cares deep. 深い is deep. In compounds it's しん, like your shin: 深夜 late night.

様.name: Manner
様.meaning: A <radical>tree</radical>, a <radical>sheep</radical> and a <radical>splash</radical>. The sheep drinks from the tree's water in a very polite <kanji>manner</kanji>. Stick it after a name and it's a very polite "Mr./Ms.".
様.reading: It does yo-yo tricks, よう, politely. 様子 is appearance; さま after a name, お客様.

共.name: Together
共.meaning: Two posts joined at the top on two legs. They stand <kanji>together</kanji>.
共.reading: They're from Kyoto, きょう. 共通 is common; 共に together.

港.name: Harbor
港.meaning: <radical>Water</radical>, <radical>together</radical> and <radical>oneself</radical>. Boats huddle together on the water, safe in the <kanji>harbor</kanji>.
港.reading: A koala, こう, is the harbour master. 空港 is an airport; みなと on its own is a harbour.

路.name: Road
路.meaning: A <radical>foot</radical> for <radical>each</radical> person. Many feet wear down a <kanji>road</kanji>.
路.reading: Someone rows a rowing boat, ろ, down it when it floods. 道路 is a road.

他.name: Other
他.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> next to a <radical>scorpion</radical>. Not you: the <kanji>other</kanji> person gets stung.
他.reading: They get a taco, た, as compensation. 他人 is a stranger; その他 etc.

客.name: Guest
客.meaning: <radical>Each</radical> person under your <radical>roof</radical> who doesn't live there is a <kanji>guest</kanji>.
客.reading: They arrived by kayak, きゃく. お客さん is a guest or customer.

登.name: Climb
登.meaning: A <radical>tent</radical> on top of a <radical>bean</radical> stalk. You <kanji>climb</kanji> the beanstalk and camp at the top.
登.reading: A toad, とう, climbs with you. 登る is to climb; 登山 mountain climbing (と).

束.name: Bundle
束.meaning: A <radical>tree</radical> with a <radical>mouth</radical> tied round its middle. Tie the sticks into a <kanji>bundle</kanji>.
束.reading: Tie it up with a sock, そく. 約束 is a promise; 花束 a bouquet.

速.name: Fast
速.reading: It's a bundle of socks, そく, flying off. 速い is fast; 高速 high speed.

号.name: Number
号.meaning: A <radical>mouth</radical> over a line with a hook. Shout out your <kanji>number</kanji>.
号.reading: You're number one at golf, ごう. 番号 is a number; 信号 a traffic light.

苦.name: Suffering
苦.meaning: <radical>Grass</radical> that's <radical>old</radical> tastes bitter. Eating it is <kanji>suffering</kanji>.
苦.reading: A cuckoo, く, is forced to eat it. 苦しい is painful; 苦い bitter (にがい).

具.name: Tool
具.meaning: An <radical>eye</radical> on a stand with <radical>eight</radical> legs. It's a strange <kanji>tool</kanji>.
具.reading: It's covered in goo, ぐ. 道具 is a tool; 家具 furniture.

返.name: Return
返.meaning: <radical>Against</radical> your will, on a <radical>scooter</radical>. You have to <kanji>return</kanji> what you took.
返.reading: You give back a hen, へん. 返す is to return; 返事 a reply.

宿.name: Inn
宿.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> and a <radical>hundred</radical> under a <radical>roof</radical>. A hundred people under one roof: it's an <kanji>inn</kanji>.
宿.reading: It's full of shooting stars, しゅく, painted on the ceiling. 宿題 is homework; やど an inn.

薬.name: Medicine
薬.meaning: <radical>Grass</radical> over <radical>fun</radical>. Herbs that make you feel better are <kanji>medicine</kanji>.
薬.reading: It's made from yak milk, やく. 薬 on its own is くすり; 薬局 a pharmacy.

幸.name: Happiness
幸.meaning: <radical>Dirt</radical>, <radical>horns</radical> and something <radical>dry</radical>. A goat with dry, cosy ground to stand on: pure <kanji>happiness</kanji>.
幸.reading: A koala, こう, is happy too. 幸せ is happiness; 幸福 happiness.

等.name: Equal
等.meaning: <radical>Bamboo</radical> strips at the <radical>temple</radical>, all cut <kanji>equal</kanji> length.
等.reading: A toad, とう, checks them. 平等 is equality; 一等 first class.

曲.name: Music
曲.meaning: The <radical>sun</radical> held up by <radical>clasped hands</radical>, bent into a curve. Bend sound like that and you get <kanji>music</kanji>.
曲.reading: It's a Kyoto song, きょく. 曲 is a song; 曲がる to bend.

庭.name: Garden
庭.meaning: A <radical>court</radical> under a <radical>canopy</radical>. The inner court with a roof round it is the <kanji>garden</kanji>.
庭.reading: There's a table, てい, in the middle. 家庭 is home; にわ on its own is a garden.

息.name: Breath
息.meaning: Your<radical>self</radical> (your nose) over your <radical>heart</radical>. Air goes in through your nose to your heart: <kanji>breath</kanji>.
息.reading: You hold your breath in a stinky sock, そく. 息 on its own is いき; 休息 rest; 息子 son (むす).

列.name: Row
列.meaning: <radical>Bones</radical> and a <radical>knife</radical>. The butcher lays the bones out in a <kanji>row</kanji>.
列.reading: Each one has a letter, れつ, on it. 列 is a line; 列車 a train.

遊.name: Play
遊.meaning: A <radical>child</radical> with a <radical>gun</radical> on a <radical>scooter</radical>, going in every <radical>direction</radical>. That's how kids <kanji>play</kanji>.
遊.reading: They play the ukulele, ゆう, too. 遊ぶ is to play.

君.name: You
君.meaning: A <radical>flag</radical> over a <radical>mouth</radical>. Wave the flag, open your mouth, and call out to <kanji>you</kanji>. After a name it's a friendly "Mr." for boys.
君.reading: You own a coon hound, くん. 田中君, Tanaka-kun; きみ is "you".

酒.name: Alcohol
酒.reading: Pour it in a shoe, しゅ. On its own it's さけ; 居酒屋 is a pub (ざか).

非.name: Not
非.meaning: The <radical>wrong</radical> radical: two halves facing away from each other. <kanji>Not</kanji>, un-.
非.reading: You step on a heel, ひ, and it's all wrong. 非常 is emergency; 是非 by all means.

悲.name: Sad
悲.reading: You lost your heel, ひ. 悲しい is sad.

暗.name: Dark
暗.meaning: The <radical>sun</radical> next to a <radical>sound</radical>. The sun's gone, you can only hear things: it's <kanji>dark</kanji>.
暗.reading: An ant, あん, is crawling on you in the dark. 暗い is dark; 暗記 memorisation.

陽.name: Sunshine
陽.meaning: A <radical>building</radical>, <radical>dawn</radical> and a <radical>banner</radical>. The banner on the building glows in the <kanji>sunshine</kanji>.
陽.reading: Do yo-yo tricks, よう, in the sun. 太陽 is the sun.

歯.name: Tooth
歯.meaning: <radical>Stop</radical> over a <radical>container</radical> full of <radical>rice</radical>. Stop! Your <kanji>tooth</kanji> is chewing rice.
歯.reading: A sheep, し, has perfect teeth. On its own a tooth is は; 歯医者 a dentist.

礼.name: Thanks
礼.meaning: A <radical>swan</radical> bowing at an <radical>altar</radical>. It's giving <kanji>thanks</kanji>.
礼.reading: It fires a ray gun, れい, in salute. お礼 is thanks; 失礼 rude.

昔.name: Long Ago
昔.meaning: <radical>Clasped hands</radical> over the <radical>sun</radical>. You fold your hands and remember the sunny days <kanji>long ago</kanji>.
昔.reading: むかし: "moo, cashier!" Long ago, cows ran the shops. 昔 is long ago.

泳.name: Swim
泳.meaning: <radical>Water</radical> that goes on for <radical>eternal</radical> distance. You <kanji>swim</kanji> and swim.
泳.reading: Swimming next to you is an ace, えい, Olympic swimmer. 泳ぐ is to swim; 水泳 swimming.

箱.name: Box
箱.meaning: <radical>Bamboo</radical> over something <radical>mutual</radical>. You weave bamboo together into a <kanji>box</kanji>.
箱.reading: はこ: a hacker hides in the box. 箱 is a box; 本箱 a bookcase (ばこ).

寒.name: Cold
寒.meaning: <radical>Three</radical> people and <radical>eight</radical> blankets under a <radical>roof</radical>, with <radical>ice</radical> on the floor. It's <kanji>cold</kanji>.
寒.reading: A kangaroo, かん, crawls in to warm up. 寒い is cold.

議.name: Deliberation
議.reading: A goose goes "ぎ!" to interrupt. 会議 is a meeting; 議論 a debate.

民.name: People
民.meaning: A tall figure with a hook for a hand, holding everyone together. The <kanji>people</kanji>.
民.reading: Give everyone a mint, みん. 国民 is citizens; 市民 townspeople.

連.name: Take Along
連.meaning: A <radical>car</radical> on a <radical>scooter</radical>. The scooter tows the car: it's <kanji>take along</kanji> day.
連.reading: You look through a lens, れん, to check it's still attached. 連れる is to take along; 連絡 contact.

選.name: Choose
選.meaning: Two of <radical>oneself</radical> standing <radical>together</radical> on a <radical>scooter</radical>. You have to <kanji>choose</kanji> which one drives.
選.reading: Flip a cent, せん, to choose. 選ぶ is to choose; 選手 a player.

関.name: Connection
関.meaning: A <radical>gate</radical> with <radical>heaven</radical> inside. It's the <kanji>connection</kanji> between earth and heaven.
関.reading: A kangaroo, かん, guards it. 関係 is a relationship.

単.name: Single
単.meaning: <radical>Sparkle</radical> on top of a <radical>shell</radical>. One <kanji>single</kanji> shiny shell.
単.reading: It's a tank shell, たん. 簡単 is simple; 単語 a word.

戦.name: War
戦.meaning: A <radical>single</radical> <radical>halberd</radical>. It only takes one weapon to start a <kanji>war</kanji>.
戦.reading: It started over one cent, せん. 戦争 is war; 戦う to fight.

最.name: Most
最.meaning: The <radical>sun</radical> over <radical>take</radical>. You take the <kanji>most</kanji> sun on the beach.
最.reading: Swing a scythe, さい, to get the best spot. 最近 is recently; 最高 the best.

約.name: Promise
約.meaning: <radical>Thread</radical> <radical>wrap</radical>ped round a <radical>drop</radical>. Tie a thread round your finger so you remember your <kanji>promise</kanji>.
約.reading: You promised the yak, やく. 約束 is a promise; 予約 a reservation.

法.name: Law
法.meaning: <radical>Water</radical> that is in the <radical>past</radical>. Water flows one way only, like the <kanji>law</kanji>.
法.reading: The police spray you with a hose, ほう. 方法 is a method; 法律 law.

要.name: Need
要.meaning: <radical>West</radical> over a <radical>woman</radical>. She heads west because she has a <kanji>need</kanji>.
要.reading: She needs a yo-yo, よう. 必要 is necessary; 要る to need.

治.name: Cure
治.meaning: <radical>Water</radical> on a <radical>pedestal</radical>. Sacred water on a stand that can <kanji>cure</kanji> anything.
治.reading: It cures a jeep, じ, even. 政治 is politics; 治る to heal (なお).

成.name: Become
成.meaning: A <radical>halberd</radical> with a <radical>hook</radical> and a <radical>slide</radical>. Train hard with it and you'll <kanji>become</kanji> a warrior.
成.reading: You sail, せい, off to find glory. 成功 is success; 成る to become.

幾.name: How Many
幾.meaning: Two <radical>cocoon</radical>s, a <radical>halberd</radical> and a <radical>person</radical>. The guard counts the cocoons: <kanji>how many</kanji>?
幾.reading: Lock them up with a key, き. 幾つ is how many.

機.name: Machine
機.meaning: A <radical>tree</radical> and <radical>how many</radical>. Count the parts carved from wood: it's a <kanji>machine</kanji>.
機.reading: Start it with a key, き. 飛行機 is an aeroplane; 機会 an opportunity.

加.name: Add
加.meaning: <radical>Power</radical> and a <radical>mouth</radical>. Shout for more power: <kanji>add</kanji> it!
加.reading: Add it to your car, か. 参加 is participation; 加える to add.

続.name: Continue
続.meaning: <radical>Thread</radical> you <radical>sell</radical>. As long as you keep selling thread, the business will <kanji>continue</kanji>.
続.reading: A zombie, ぞく, keeps buying it. 続く is to continue; 続ける to keep on.

初.name: First
初.meaning: <radical>Clothes</radical> and a <radical>sword</radical>. The <kanji>first</kanji> step in making clothes is cutting the cloth.
初.reading: Dig the shovel in first, しょ. 最初 is first; 初めて for the first time.

産.name: Produce
産.meaning: <radical>Stand</radical> under a <radical>cliff</radical> where new <radical>life</radical> begins. The land <kanji>produce</kanji>s.
産.reading: Under the sun, さん, everything grows. お土産 is a souvenir; 生産 production.

得.name: Gain
得.meaning: <radical>Going</radical> out at <radical>dawn</radical> and <radical>glue</radical>ing everything you find to yourself. That's how you <kanji>gain</kanji>.
得.reading: You gain a toaster, とく. 得意 is being good at; 得る to gain.

告.name: Tell
告.meaning: A <radical>cow</radical> over a <radical>mouth</radical>. The cow opens its mouth to <kanji>tell</kanji> you something.
告.reading: It pops a cork, こく, first. 広告 is an advertisement; 報告 a report.

参.name: Participate
参.meaning: Something <radical>private</radical> above someone <radical>big</radical> with long <radical>hair</radical>. The big hairy guy wants to <kanji>participate</kanji> too.
参.reading: He joins in under the sun, さん. 参加 is participation; 参る to go (humble).

利.name: Profit
利.meaning: <radical>Grain</radical> and a <radical>knife</radical>. Cut the harvest and sell it for <kanji>profit</kanji>.
利.reading: You buy a reef, り, with it. 便利 is convenient; 利用 use.

信.name: Believe
信.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> and what they <radical>say</radical>. If they keep their word, you <kanji>believe</kanji> them.
信.reading: Swear it on your shin, しん. 信じる is to believe; 信号 a traffic light.

側.name: Side
側.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> next to a <radical>rule</radical>. People always stand on one <kanji>side</kanji> of the rule.
側.reading: One sock on each side: sock, そく. On its own it's かわ or がわ: 右側, right side.

昨.name: Yesterday
昨.meaning: The <radical>sun</radical> with a saw-shaped thing on its right. The sun already went down: that was <kanji>yesterday</kanji>.
昨.reading: You carried it home in a sack, さく. 昨日 is yesterday (きのう); 昨年 last year.

官.name: Official
官.meaning: Two <radical>mouth</radical>s stacked under a <radical>roof</radical>. It's a government building full of mouths: an <kanji>official</kanji>'s office.
官.reading: A kangaroo, かん, sits at the desk. 警官 is a police officer.

変.name: Change
変.meaning: A <radical>top hat</radical> with things sliding off it on <radical>winter</radical> legs. It's a <kanji>change</kanji>, and it's <kanji>strange</kanji>.
変.reading: It turns into a hen, へん. 変 is strange; 大変 terrible; 変わる to change.

果.name: Fruit
果.meaning: A <radical>rice paddy</radical> on top of a <radical>tree</radical>. The paddy is the <kanji>fruit</kanji>: the <kanji>result</kanji> of all the tree's work.
果.reading: It falls on your car, か. 結果 is a result; 果物 fruit (くだもの).

必.name: Certain
必.meaning: A <radical>heart</radical> with a <radical>slide</radical> through it. The arrow went straight through: it's <kanji>certain</kanji>.
必.reading: It was a hit, ひつ. 必要 is necessary; 必ず certainly.

争.name: Conflict
争.meaning: A <radical>broom</radical> with a <radical>barb</radical> through it and something <radical>slide</radical>ing off the top. Brooms fight in a <kanji>conflict</kanji>.
争.reading: They fight over a soda can, そう. 戦争 is war; 争う to compete.

位.name: Rank
位.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> who <radical>stand</radical>s up in court. Everyone stands in order of <kanji>rank</kanji>.
位.reading: The lowest rank is an eel, い. 一位 is first place; くらい about.

置.name: Put
置.meaning: A <radical>net</radical> over something you <radical>fix</radical>ed. <kanji>Put</kanji> it down under a net so it stays put.
置.reading: A cheetah, ち, tries to steal it. 置く is to put; 位置 position.

費.name: Cost
費.meaning: A <radical>bow</radical> with a <radical>stick</radical> through it, sitting on a <radical>shell</radical>. Weapons <kanji>cost</kanji> a lot of money.
費.reading: You pay with a heel, ひ, because you're broke. 費用 is expenses; 消費 consumption.

付.name: Attach
付.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> with <radical>glue</radical>. They <kanji>attach</kanji> things to everything.
付.reading: They glue on a hoof, ふ. 付ける is to attach; 受付 reception.

説.name: Explanation
説.meaning: <radical>Say</radical> something to your <radical>older brother</radical> with <radical>eight</radical> reasons. You give an <kanji>explanation</kanji>.
説.reading: Your explanation comes with a set of diagrams, せつ. 説明 is an explanation; 小説 a novel.

夫.name: Husband
夫.meaning: Big (<kanji>大</kanji>) with an extra line through the top: a man with a pin in his topknot. He's a <kanji>husband</kanji> now.
夫.reading: He trips on a hoof, ふ. 夫 on its own is おっと; 大丈夫 fine (ぶ).

害.name: Harm
害.meaning: <radical>Life</radical> and a <radical>mouth</radical> under a <radical>roof</radical>. Something inside the house wants to do <kanji>harm</kanji>.
害.reading: It's a guy in a fedora, がい. 被害 is damage; 害 harm.

席.name: Seat
席.meaning: A <radical>towel</radical> and a <radical>cross</radical> under a <radical>canopy</radical>. Lay a towel down to save your <kanji>seat</kanji>.
席.reading: Or put a sack of rice, せき, on it. 席 is a seat; 出席 attendance.

残.name: Remain
残.meaning: <radical>Bones</radical>, <radical>three</radical> and a <radical>halberd</radical>. After the battle only bones <kanji>remain</kanji>.
残.reading: And a zany clown, ざん. 残念 is a pity; 残る to remain.

念.name: Thought
念.meaning: <radical>Now</radical> over your <radical>heart</radical>. What's in your heart right now is a <kanji>thought</kanji>.
念.reading: A nun, ねん, reads your thoughts. 残念 is a pity; 記念 commemoration.

労.name: Labor
労.meaning: <radical>Sparkle</radical> over a <radical>lid</radical> over <radical>power</radical>. You sweat so much you sparkle: hard <kanji>labor</kanji>.
労.reading: You haul a rope, ろう, all day. 苦労 is hardship; 労働 labour.

例.name: Example
例.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> next to a <radical>row</radical>. The first person in the row is the <kanji>example</kanji>.
例.reading: They hold a ray gun, れい. 例えば is for example.

然.name: Nature
然.meaning: A <radical>dog</radical> cooking <radical>moon</radical>-meat over a <radical>fire</radical>. That's just <kanji>nature</kanji>.
然.reading: A zen monk, ぜん, accepts it. 自然 is nature; 全然 not at all.

伝.name: Transmit
伝.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> passing <radical>two</radical> <radical>private</radical> messages along. They <kanji>transmit</kanji> them.
伝.reading: They send them to a dentist, でん. 伝える is to convey; 手伝う to help.

働.name: Work
働.reading: They work at a donut shop, どう. 働く is to work; 労働 labour.

景.name: Scenery
景.reading: You paint it on a cake, けい. 景色 is scenery; 景気 the economy.

好.name: Like
好.meaning: A <radical>woman</radical> and a <radical>child</radical>. She's very fond of the kid: she <kanji>like</kanji>s them.
好.reading: She also likes koalas, こう. 好き is liking (す); 好物 a favourite food.

失.name: Lose
失.meaning: A <radical>husband</radical> with something <radical>slide</radical>ing off him. He's starting to <kanji>lose</kanji> things.
失.reading: Like his shirt, しつ. 失礼 is rude; 失敗 failure.

差.name: Difference
差.meaning: A <radical>sheep</radical> and <radical>craft</radical> with a <radical>slide</radical> between them. Can you spot the <kanji>difference</kanji>?
差.reading: Cut the difference with a saw, さ. 差 is a difference; 交差点 an intersection.

末.name: End
末.meaning: A tree with the top line longer than the branch below. That's the very <kanji>end</kanji> of the tree.
末.reading: Roll out a mat, まつ, at the end. 週末 is the weekend; 年末 the year's end.

種.name: Seed
種.meaning: <radical>Grain</radical> that's <radical>heavy</radical>. The heaviest grains are saved as <kanji>seed</kanji>s.
種.reading: Keep them in a shoe, しゅ. 種類 is a type; たね a seed.

亡.name: Deceased
亡.meaning: A <radical>top hat</radical> over someone <radical>hiding</radical>. They've gone away for good: <kanji>deceased</kanji>.
亡.reading: A bow and arrow, ぼう, did it. 死亡 is death; 亡くなる to pass away.

望.name: Hope
望.meaning: The <radical>deceased</radical>, the <radical>moon</radical> and the <radical>king</radical>. The dead king looks up at the moon and <kanji>hope</kanji>s.
望.reading: He shoots a bow and arrow, ぼう, at it. 希望 is hope; 望む to wish.
